question: I need a ride, any taxi or auto around Nagercoil?
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name, sc.subcategoryname FROM shop_details sd JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = sd.id AND sa.is_default = 1 JOIN subcategories sc ON sc.id = sd.subcategory_id WHERE sd.status = 1 AND sa.city = 'Nagercoil' AND sc.subcategoryname IN ('Taxi', 'Auto Rickshaw');
